name: Tabitha
bio: Tabitha, also called Dorcas, a disciple in Joppa known for her good works and charity to the poor, died and was mourned by the widows she had helped. Peter, summoned from nearby Lydda, prayed over her body and said, "Tabitha, arise"; she opened her eyes and sat up, and news of the miracle spread, leading many in Joppa to believe (Acts 9:36-42).
